name: Live Response & Triage
description: Ability to collect and triage evidence from running systems during an incident. Covers order of volatility, volatile data collection (processes, network connections, logged-on users, scheduled tasks, loaded modules), targeted triage collection with tools such as KAPE, Velociraptor, and UAC, EDR-based remote collection, rapid scoping and indicator sweeps across fleets, and documenting the footprint of live response actions. Full memory imaging belongs to DFIR-MEM-ACQUISITION and deep artifact analysis to the Disk Forensics skills.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to live response or triage collection

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands why and how evidence is collected from live systems
evidence: Can explain the order of volatility (RFC 3227) and its effect on collection sequencing
Understands the trade-off between live response and powering a system down
Can name common triage collection tools and what they collect

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs live response collections under supervision using established playbooks
evidence: Collected volatile data from Windows and Linux hosts using lab scripts under guidance
Ran KAPE or Velociraptor triage collections and verified output integrity with hashes
Documented commands executed and their timestamps in case notes reviewed by a supervisor

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently performs live response and scopes incidents across multiple hosts
evidence: Independently performed live response on 10+ hosts across Windows, Linux, and macOS
Ran fleet-wide indicator hunts (e.g. Velociraptor hunts, EDR queries) to scope compromise
Selected collection depth per host (triage versus full image) based on investigative need
Live response records pass QA review for completeness and footprint documentation

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Leads triage at enterprise scale and builds collection capability
evidence: Led triage and scoping across environments of 1,000+ endpoints during an incident
Developed custom Velociraptor artifacts or KAPE targets/modules for new artifact sources
Handles collection from constrained systems (servers that cannot be rebooted, hypervisors, appliances)
Mentors responders on live response tradecraft and footprint minimisation

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines the lab's live response methodology and validates its tooling
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's live response and triage procedures
Validated triage tools for evidence integrity and system impact against ground truth
Published research or tooling for live response or fleet-scale triage
Provides expert testimony on the soundness of live-collected evidence

assessment_methods.description: Given a lab network with a seeded compromise, perform volatile data and triage collection on affected hosts, scope the compromise across the fleet, and document every action and hash
Review live response logs and triage packages from recent incidents for order-of-volatility compliance, integrity verification, and footprint documentation
